apps.name: OpenNOW Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Corrects build 121 direct HDR renderer upside-down image by preserving native top-left texture orientation. Disables host dynamic frame control for fixed requested FPS and removes the 85-percent decode-FPS adjustment. Keeps 4K/10-bit HDR, bounded async AV1 and direct Metal rendering. Adds clock, CPU and GPU timing to local performance diagnostics. Device build, seven targeted tests and hardware color/native-orientation checks passed. Fresh stream required; actual iPad FPS/stutter improvement remains unverified.
